quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: When turning right on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You may turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When you turn, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: You are waiting in a line at a stop sign. After the cars ahead pass through and there is no cross traffic, you:

options.text: May go through without stopping again.
Must stop again at the stop sign before going.
May roll slowly through the stop sign.
May follow the car ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop again at the stop sign before going.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at a stop sign and check for other traffic before going. Do not skip the stop just because other cars are around you.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear its siren, you must pull to the side of the road right away and stop.

questions.question: A car ahead has bright headlights on. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the other car.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps the bright lights from blinding you and lets you see the road so you can stay in your lane until the other car passes.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way to turn left when you see which light?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in the direction the arrow points. Oncoming traffic must stop for you when you have a left turn arrow.

questions.question: Highway hypnosis happens when you:

options.text: Stare at the road for a long time without paying attention.
Get too much sleep before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stare at the road for a long time without paying attention.
questions.explanation: Highway hypnosis occurs when you stare ahead at the road without actively watching what is around you. This causes you to zone out and miss traffic that is slowing or stopping in front of you.

questions.question: Lack of sleep affects your driving the same way as:
questions.explanation: Tiredness and alcohol have the same effects on driving safety. Being awake for 18 hours impairs driving as much as having a blood alcohol level of 0.05 percent. Being awake for 24 hours has the same effect as a blood alcohol level of 0.10 percent.

questions.question: Two white lines across a lane mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way in crosswalks.
Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must get out of the way of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalks show pedestrians where to safely cross. You must always stop for pedestrians who are in a crosswalk.

questions.question: When driving on wet or icy roads, you should:

options.text: Drive the same as on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On wet or icy roads, increase your distance from the car ahead. Your car will take longer to stop than it does on dry roads.

questions.question: What can distract drivers and increase crash risk?
questions.explanation: Cell phones, radios, and CD players can all distract you while driving. This increases your risk of crashing.

questions.question: What does a "Reduced speed, 35 mph" sign mean?

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should only reduce speed to 35 mph in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: A reduced speed sign tells you that a new speed limit begins right at that sign. You must follow the new speed limit from that point on.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What should you do when preparing to turn left?

options.text: Slow down gradually while checking your rearview mirror.
Watch for oncoming vehicles and pedestrians.

questions.explanation: Before turning left, signal three to five seconds ahead. Check your rearview mirror and slow down gradually. Move into the left lane on a multilane road. Check for traffic and pedestrians, then turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a good defensive driver do?

options.text: Watches what other drivers are doing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers are doing.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches other drivers and expects problems. This helps prevent crashes even when other drivers are distracted.

questions.question: When can you drive around the gates at a railroad crossing?

options.text: When the lights have stopped flashing.
When other drivers drive around the gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when warning signals appear. These signals include flashing red lights, lowered gates, a flagger, or train sounds. Never drive around a lowered gate.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at an open intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an open intersection at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. The other driver must yield and wait until it is safe to go.

questions.question: How can you prevent drowsiness on long trips?

options.text: Move your eyes side to side as you drive.

questions.explanation: Take regular stops on long trips to rest and stretch. Do this even if you do not feel tired yet.

questions.question: A driver entering interstate traffic from an entrance ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Assume other drivers will move for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering the interstate from an entrance ramp, you must yield to traffic already on the highway. Merge safely when there is a gap.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: Drivers may pass even if it is dangerous.
Drivers may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. Dashed white lines can be crossed to pass or change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light, who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light. This is true whether or not there is a crosswalk.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption but does not prevent intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: Where are stop lines (solid white lines) painted across traffic lanes?
questions.explanation: Stop lines are solid white lines at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show exactly where drivers must stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the most difficult driving season
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid levels in winter
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe
Snow tires are the best choice for your vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter is the most difficult driving season. Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires improve your vehicle's grip on slippery roads.
